title: BiasFilter: An Inference-Time Debiasing Framework for Large Language Models
findings: The proposed BIASFILTER framework consistently and significantly reduces stereotypical bias related to religion across various large language models in both text continuation and conversation tasks, outperforming other debiasing baselines.
